pages.text: Turns a $(l)Bubba Star$() into a $(l)Celestial Bubba Star$(). It lasts one night, under open sky.$(br2)Build the circle, put the Bubba Star on the altar and light every candle, at night. Whichever you do last starts it. If something is missing, you're told what.

pages.name: Celestial Ritual
pages.text: Each corner pedestal holds an echo shard. Candles: 4 next to the altar, 2 near each pedestal.
$(l)Win before sunrise:$()$(li)100 pollinations inside the circle$(li)50 of them by starlight bees$(li)one each by Glow, Amethyst, Deep Dark, Obsidian, Soul, Prismarine, Frost, Corrupt Nature bees

$(l)Dark bees$() appear every 30 to 60 seconds and fly to a candle to snuff it. While a candle is out the ritual pauses: relight it. One hit kills them; royal guards attack them.$(br2)$(l)It fails$() if the circle is broken, the star is taken, everyone leaves, a bee from the circle dies, or the sun rises.
$(l)Tip: bring 4 starlight hives$() (20 bees), plus a hive of each of the 8 bees with their flowers inside the circle. Keep a sword ready for dark bees.
